about.heading: Hello World! I'm Moro 👋
about.portraitAlt: Gabriel Moro giving a talk, holding a microphone and pointing at the projected slide beside him.
about.intro: I've worked in mobile development since 2017 — today I'm at Kobe, a mobile commerce platform. I also write, record and speak about what I learn along the way. I like code, music, and explaining things in a simple way, without the fluff.

sections.title: What I do
paragraphs: Day to day, I build mobile apps with Flutter, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform. I've worked with architecture, testing, performance, and that part nobody sees: keeping code alive and easy to change.
I also share what I learn in articles, videos and talks — always with engineering context and examples you can apply to your own project.

sections.title: Where I come from
paragraphs: I'm from Uruguaiana (Rio Grande do Sul), a city on the border between Brazil and Argentina. Since I was 12, I've always enjoyed learning guitar and playing at church. Music taught me to listen before playing, to repeat until it feels natural, and to notice when something is out of harmony.
Since then, music has stayed with me — and became a lens for seeing other things, software included.

sections.title: Code is art, too
paragraphs: I like to think of programming as a form of art: it has rhythm, composition, harmony choices, and a lot of practice hidden behind the result.
That's why I like simple, well-organized code with context. Less abstract theory, more examples and trade-offs you can adapt to your own project.

about.contactText: Want to trade ideas about mobile or maybe book a mentoring session with me? Reach me by email or LinkedIn — I answer personally.
